title: Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract: Agent-Taken Arrears Payment Toward an Extension
content:
**Servicing Policy Manual and desk system reference — Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.**

## Scope

This policy figures the arrears payment a Kestrel agent takes by phone, from the customer's bank account, toward the past-due installments of a retail installment contract other than its oldest past-due installment, when the customer has asked for that oldest installment to be extended.

## Posting

The payment is posted under the payment posting rule: the contract must be in a payable status, the posting day follows the cutoff rule, and the agent-assisted ACH channel carries no channel fee.

For an arrears payment an agent takes toward an extension, and only for such a payment, the payment is recorded on the contract on its posting day with its amount, channel and purpose, and the nightly posting cycle that closes that day applies it in the product's allocation order, first to simple interest accrued over the interest accrual days at the contract APR on the product's day-basis year, then to principal until the installments due are satisfied, then to fees due, and any remainder to principal; a good-faith payment toward an extension and a catch-up payment are recorded and applied the same way under their own policies, and every other payment is applied in the allocation order when it posts, first to simple interest accrued over the interest accrual days at the contract APR on the product's day-basis year, then to principal until the installments due are satisfied, then to fees due, and any remainder to principal, and is not posted under this policy.

## When the amount is worked out

The arrears payment amount is worked out only once the late charge owed on the installment the contract's next due date shows, when a returned payment has re-opened it, stands on the contract.

Put another way: where a returned payment has re-opened the installment the next due date shows, the arrears payment amount waits until the late charge owed on that installment stands on the contract.

## Taking the payment

The payment is posted with the agent-side tool `post_arrears_payment_6321a7ae`. It is a hidden tool: the agent first unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, having the customer's authorization to draw from their bank account.

**What one call does.** It posts one installment payment to the contract through the agent-assisted phone ACH channel with no channel fee, on its posting day, which is today when the payment is received earlier than 8:00 p.m. Central Time on a business day and otherwise the next business day (Saturdays, Sundays and US federal holidays, with a holiday that falls on a weekend observed on the nearest weekday, are not business days), recording its amount, channel and purpose, and the contract's last payment date becomes the posting day; the split of the payment across interest, principal and fees is applied by the nightly posting cycle, not by the call. The customer can be told the payment confirmation number and the amount posted.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `retail_contract_id` | the reference number of the retail installment contract the payment posts to, as returned by the retail contract lookup (`find_retail_contracts`) |
| `payment_amount` | the payment amount drawn from the customer's bank account, in USD with 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent |
| `funding_account_last4` | the last four digits of the bank account the customer authorizes the payment from, written as 4 digits, or empty when not applicable |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the payment confirmation number (an opaque text identifier), the contract reference, the amount posted in USD with 2 decimal places and the posting day (YYYY-MM-DD). A sentence that starts with "Payment posted" means the payment is on the contract.
